<!-- Optional template for new features with a design, public interface, or cross-component workflow.
Use the default template for routine fixes and maintenance. Remove sections that do not apply.
Chinese version: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/feature_zh.md -->

## Goal

<!-- Describe the user problem and the outcome this feature enables. -->

## Design

<!-- Explain the core flow, responsibility boundaries, and important design choices.
Link the proposal or focused design document rather than reproducing it.
Use a diagram only when it makes the relationships clearer. -->

## Interface

<!-- Show a typical command, configuration, or API call and its observable result.
Explain only the parameters needed to understand the example.
Keep current usage and planned interfaces distinct without repeating scope disclaimers. -->

## Validation

<!-- Summarize the actual environment, behavior exercised, and results.
Include relevant performance or model-quality measurements when available.
Mention unresolved issues once when they affect review; do not copy the execution log. -->

## Impact

<!-- Optional. Explain changes to existing usage, deployment, permissions, or compatibility,
and any migration the user needs to perform. Omit when there is no material impact. -->

## Follow-ups

<!-- Optional for incremental delivery. List the next independently usable features and
necessary dependencies. Keep the detailed roadmap in the design document. -->

## Related

<!-- Link the issue, proposal, and user guide. For stacked PRs, identify the predecessor and base. -->
